# IAppliedSetting&lt;T&gt; interface

A saved setting that the game applies once, when it loads the saved options, and keeps in effect separately. So its value in effect can differ from its saved value: the player can apply a value without saving it, and a mod can override it for the session.

```csharp
public interface IAppliedSetting<T> : ISavedSetting<T>, ISessionSetting<T>
```
